metadata.description: Comprehensive Core/Content/Utility feature inventory with sequential implementation status for session 80 - verification and improvement phase.

features.name: Shared DLL contracts and enums
features.description: GameCommon.dll and SharedProtocol.dll provide shared enums/contracts for client and server.
features.verification_notes: Needs verification that all shared enums are properly referenced

features.name: Hydrology signature and profile sync
features.description: Hydrology signature v32 and map-control profile version 36 synchronized across server/client config and runtime.
features.verification_notes: Verify v32 signature and v36 profile are consistent across all configs

features.name: Server world-map adaptive queue policy
features.description: Queue limit/pressure/slack/load-shedding are computed adaptively for map chunk generation and profile signatures.
features.verification_notes: Verify emergency brake threshold is properly implemented

features.name: Client world-map adaptive queue policy
features.description: Unity world map controller uses adaptive queue/backoff/load-shedding settings from JSON configs.
features.verification_notes: Verify client queue policy matches server policy

features.name: Network communication layer
features.description: TCP/UDP network communication with packet serialization and deserialization.
features.verification_notes: Verify all using statements and references are valid

features.name: Protocol registry and validation
features.description: Google.Protobuf descriptors and runtime registry are validated on startup and probe flows.
features.verification_notes: Verify all protobuf messages are properly registered and validated

features.name: Session management
features.description: Player session lifecycle management including connection, authentication, and disconnection.
features.verification_notes: Verify session state transitions are properly handled

features.name: World generation pipeline
features.description: Core terrain generation pipeline with stage-based processing for biome, cave, river, lake generation.
features.verification_notes: Review and verify cave/river/lake generation algorithms

features.name: Chunk management system
features.description: Chunk loading, unloading, and synchronization between server and client.
features.verification_notes: Verify chunk synchronization is working correctly

features.name: Block registry system
features.description: Centralized block type registry with properties and metadata.
features.verification_notes: Verify all block types are properly registered

features.name: Cave hyporheic vent seal
features.description: Added cave sealing pass to prevent wet karst bypass artifacts across chunk seams.
features.verification_notes: Review cave generation algorithm for improvements

features.name: River estuary convergence bridge
features.description: Added damping pass to stabilize branch cutoffs and improve seam continuity near river mouths.
features.verification_notes: Review river generation algorithm for improvements

features.name: Lake lagoon overflow bridge
features.description: Added overflow continuity pass to stabilize lagoon spill paths near coastal basins.
features.verification_notes: Review lake generation algorithm for improvements

features.name: Lagoon-karst terrain coordinator coupling
features.description: Hydrology/flow/erosion coupling pass aligns cave/river/lake transition behavior.
features.verification_notes: Verify terrain coupling is working correctly

features.name: Terrain content generation (cave/river/lake)
features.description: Biome terrain and hydrology content generation with improved cave/river/lake passes.
features.verification_notes: Verify terrain content generation produces expected results

features.name: World map preview content
features.description: Client preview chunks render aligned world-map terrain masks and height updates.
features.verification_notes: Verify world map preview is working correctly

features.name: Player state management
features.description: Player position, rotation, health, hunger, experience, and inventory state synchronization.
features.verification_notes: Verify player state synchronization is working correctly

features.name: Inventory system
features.description: Player inventory with main inventory, hotbar, armor slots, offhand, and crafting grid.
features.verification_notes: Verify inventory system is working correctly

features.name: Block break/place system
features.description: Block destruction and placement with progress tracking, tool durability, and drop calculation.
features.verification_notes: Verify block break/place system is working correctly

features.name: Crafting system
features.description: Recipe-based crafting with shaped, shapeless, smelting, and special recipes.
features.verification_notes: Verify crafting system is working correctly

features.name: Entity system
features.description: Entity spawning, despawning, movement, and state management for mobs, items, and projectiles.
features.verification_notes: Verify entity system is working correctly

features.name: Combat and damage system
features.description: Damage calculation with armor, effects, knockback, and death handling.
features.verification_notes: Verify combat system is working correctly

features.name: Experience and enchanting system
features.description: Experience orbs, leveling, enchantment table, and applied effects.
features.verification_notes: Verify experience system is working correctly

features.name: Time and weather system
features.description: World time progression, day/night cycle, and weather changes.
features.verification_notes: Verify time and weather system is working correctly

features.name: Chat and command system
features.description: Player chat messages with formatting and server command execution.
features.verification_notes: Verify chat system is working correctly

features.name: Particle and sound system
features.description: Visual particle effects and audio sound effects for game events.
features.verification_notes: Verify particle and sound system is working correctly

features.name: Achievement and statistics system
features.description: Player achievements tracking and statistics collection.
features.verification_notes: Verify achievement system is working correctly

features.name: Data-driven gameplay content
features.description: Items/blocks/world settings are loaded from JSON data for runtime tuning.
features.verification_notes: Verify all data files are in JSON format and properly loaded

features.name: JSON config governance
features.description: Server/client world-map runtime and queue policy parameters are JSON-managed and mirrored.
features.verification_notes: Verify all configs are in JSON format and properly structured

features.name: Protobuf generation and verification scripts
features.description: Protocol generation/verification scripts validate descriptor freshness and hashes.
features.verification_notes: Verify protobuf generation and verification scripts are working

features.name: Dummy protocol client probe (server)
features.description: Server-side dummy probe validates registry bindings, descriptor package/name, and packet round-trip.
features.verification_notes: Verify dummy client probe is working correctly

features.name: Dummy protocol client executable (tool)
features.description: CLI dummy client validates descriptor full-name/package consistency and packet round-trip/network probe.
features.verification_notes: Verify dummy client executable is working correctly

features.name: Configuration management system
features.description: Unified config manager for loading and managing JSON configuration files.
features.verification_notes: Verify config management system is working correctly

features.name: Data-driven manager
features.description: Data manager for loading and managing JSON data files (blocks, items, biomes, etc.).
features.verification_notes: Verify data-driven manager is working correctly

features.name: Build and deployment scripts
features.description: Scripts for building server, client, and running tests.
features.verification_notes: Verify build scripts are working correctly

features.name: Plans/docs update workflow
features.description: Session planning and implementation reports are maintained in plans/ and docs/.
features.verification_notes: Verify plans and docs are properly maintained
